SCRIPT.ENGLISH: No, Yuman! Who told you to ask that?!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 喂！吳宥萬！誰叫你問那種東西！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ウ・ユマンさんなんでそんなこと聞くの？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Nggak, Yuman! Siapa yang nyuruh kamu nanya begituan sih?!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ei! Quem te deu permissão pra perguntar isso?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¡Oye! ¿Quién te dijo que podías preguntar eso?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: نه، یومان! کی گفته اینو بپرسی؟!

SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 教えてくださいよ〜教えて！
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: به من بگو! به من بگو!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 미친 거 아니야? 조용히 안 해?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Are you crazy? Can’t you be quiet?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 你疯了吗？能不能安静点？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你瘋了嗎？還不安靜一點？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Udah gila, ya?!Bisa nggak diem sedikit aja nggak sih?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Você enlouqueceu? Não vai calar a boca?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: شما دیوانه هستید؟ نمیتونی ساکت باشی؟
آه، خوب، پس به من بگو.

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 아니 우유만 씨가 그걸 왜 알고 싶은데!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Why do you even want to know, Yuman?!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 不是，你为什么要知道这个！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 不是啊，你為什麼想知道這個！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: なんでウ・ユマンさんがそんなこと知りたがるの！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Emangnya kenapa sih kamu kepo, Yuman?!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: E por que isso te interessa?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¿Y por qué  te importa a ti?

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I need to know so I can be prepared.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 我也要知道，才能做準備啊
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 俺も備えなきゃいけないんです
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aku harus tahu biar bisa siap-siap.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: من باید بدانم تا بتوانم آماده شوم.

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 그니까 그걸 유만 씨가 왜 알고 대비를 하냐구
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: But… why would you need to know to be prepared?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 所以为什么要为这个做准备...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你為什麼想知道，還要做什麼準備？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: だからウ・ユマンさんどうして備えるの～
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tapi… kenapa kamu perlu siap-siap segala?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اما ... چرا باید بدانید که آماده باشید؟

SCRIPT.KOREAN: ...뭔가 회사 안에서나 밖에서나 능숙해 보이고 싶단 말이에요.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: …It’s just that I want to seem confident, both in and out of the office.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: ...就是想在公司里外都显得游刃有余嘛
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 就是...我想讓大家覺得我在公司裡或公司外都很厲害嘛

SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: …Soalnya aku pengen kelihatan percaya diri, baik di kantor maupun di luar.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: ...Não sei, só quero parecer mais confiante — dentro e fora do trabalho.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: …No sé, solo quiero verme más seguro, tanto dentro como fuera del trabajo.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: ... فقط می خواهم در دفتر و خارج از دفتر مطمئن به نظر برسم.

SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 你想在谁面前显得游刃有余？

SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Percaya diri… di depan siapa, emangnya?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: E pra quem exatamente você quer parecer tão confiante, hein?
